title: Lifetime Violation or Not?
prompt: Implement `const char *lifetime_verdict(int kind)` for five scenarios: 0 returning a pointer to a local → "dangling", 1 returning a malloc'd buffer → "valid", 2 storing a pointer to a stack array in a global → "dangling", 3 returning a pointer into a static buffer → "valid", 4 freeing then returning the freed pointer → "dangling".

tests.name: dangling scenarios
tests.hint: The object dies at return; the pointer survives — question 2 fails.

tests.name: valid scenarios
tests.hint: Heap and static storage outlive the function — the pointer's lifetime is covered.

tests.name: free-then-return
tests.hint: Free ends the lifetime immediately; the returned pointer is use-after-free by construction.
